content.body:
The French Army employed as a sniper weapon both the Lebel and the Mas rifles, although the Mas was not employed until much later on relative to the Lebel. Currently the Mas in employed in WWIIOL:BE until such time as the Lebel can be remodeled as the primary sniper rifle.
Snipers where often recruited from the finest marksman in the force. Snipers where ofen assigned to hit high-value targets. They where so highly valued and repected among themselves that they ofen followed their own universal code of ethics. Among these ethical rules was that a sniper will not kill an enemy sniper unless it was absulutly nessesary.
content.brief: WEAPON: Fusil mle 1886 m 1893 "Lebel" AMMO: Cartouche de 8 mm mle 1886 D (am) MAGAZINE: 8 round tube magazine MUZZLE VELOCITY: 716 m/s RATE OF FIRE: Single-round bolt action OTHER EQUIPMENT: APX Mle 1921 Telescopic Sight Grenade Fumigène (Smoke Grenades) (4) Combat Knife
